title.narrative: Provision of integrated nutrition, health, and WASH services to the 19 localities at the highest risk of famine.

description.narrative: This project will allow UNICEF to maintain and scale up the provision of integrated health, nutrition, and WASH services in the 14 areas at the highest risk of famine and cholera-affected states to reach:205,000 children, women and families with the provision of critical primary health care (PHC) services in the 14 areas (19 localities) at risk of famine.180,000 children and women with the provision of lifesaving nutrition services in the areas at risk of famine.114,000 children and families affected by ongoing crisis and cholera outbreak with the provision of minimum package of WASH services across seven states of Darfur (South, East and West), South Kordofan, White Nile, Gedaref and River Nile.Over 1.5 million people across Sudan, with a clear focus on 14 areas, are protected from sexual exploitation and abuse (SEA) perpetrated by the humanitarian workers. In this project, the focus will be on strengthening SEA prevention, risk mitigation, victim assistance, coordination, community engagement and promotion of reporting for accountability.NUTRITION• Ensuring early detection of malnutrition through conducting two rounds of mass screening campaigns targeting more than 100,000 children under-five, and providing lifesaving nutrition services to more than 11,000 children with SAM.• Providing micronutrient supplementation and infant and young children feeding for more than 80,000 pregnant and lactating women.• Expanding the coverage of nutrition services among the IDPs within the 14 areas through the deployment of more mobile teams and the establishment of temporary nutrition sites in the large camps.HEALTH• Enhancing effective and timely provision of integrated health and nutrition services to over 205,000 IDPs, host communities and other vulnerable groups at PHC level in UNICEF-supported facilities.• Ensuring 100 implementing partner staff receive training to support programme implementation and community health workers trained in different health topics (case management, IPC, health promotion, IMCI, EMONC).WASH• Providing access to sufficient and safe water for drinking, cooking and/or personal hygiene use to 22,500 children and families.• Supporting operations and maintenance, water chlorination/flocculation, water trucking and other quick fixes to ensure 150,000 affected people have access to sufficient safe drinking water. • Supporting construction/rehabilitation of durable gender sensitive basic sanitation facilities, including the desludging of toilets, to reach 11,500 children and families. • Provision of essential WASH supplies to reach 20,000 people. • Providing WASH services in 10 schools/health facilities (rehabilitation, operation and maintenance support). • Hygiene promotion to reach 60,000 people.Target states include all five Darfur states, Gezira, Khartoum, North and South Kordofan (14 areas/19 localities) for health, nutrition and WASH interventions related to famine prevention and cholera response. Additionally, states like Gedaref, Kassala, River Nile, West Kordofan and White Nile will also be targeted by health and WASH interventions, especially for cholera response. The target population includes internally displaced people (IDPs), refugees and host communities.
